{{Quote|Dropships from the Star Destroyer Viscount put us into position and we advanced on Salline at 0200 as Chandrila's sun rose at our backs.|Colonel Maximilian Veers, ''Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide''|<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />}}
The '''''Viscount''''' was a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] in use by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Imperial Handbook" /> Participating in the [[Pacification of Salline]] sometime in between [[2 BBY/Legends|2]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'' places the publication of the [[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide|book]] of the same name before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], and the [[Pacification of Salline]] involves the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], which was formed in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] according to [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (graphic novel)|The Force Unleashed comic]], thus the Pacification must have taken place sometime in between 2 and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> the ''Viscount'' released dropships down to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], carrying the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] [[Hammer 6|Hammer six]] and [[Hammer 8|eight]], as well as four [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]]. When the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|rebels]] attempted to escape from the Imperial forces at the [[Government center (Salline)|government center]] on the water, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] ordered the ''Viscount'' to send a [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] to intercept and eradicate them. The TIEs being successful, the battle was won for the Empire. Veers later mentioned the ''Viscount'' during a report on the battle, which was included in the [[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]].<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />
